nodes.title: Classic stacked tier
nodes.prompt: A plan upgrade card: plan name, monthly price, three features with check icons and an Upgrade button.
nodes.rationale: A classic narrow tier read top to bottom: plan name, large price, check-icon feature list, full-width upgrade action.

nodes.title: Segmented price switch
nodes.prompt: Add a monthly / annual toggle and show the annual saving.
nodes.rationale: A filled monthly/annual tab sits above the price and swaps it in place, with a 'Save 20%' badge on the Annual tab and a line under the price showing the yearly dollar saving.

nodes.title: Billing cycle choice
nodes.prompt: Add a monthly / annual toggle and show the annual saving.
nodes.rationale: No price hero or feature list: the card is a billing choice, two radio rows with price and saving help text.

nodes.title: Price-first, large number
nodes.prompt: Make the price the hero and move the saving into a badge.
nodes.rationale: The yearly per-month price leads, large and left-aligned, with the saving as a badge and a compact feature list below.

nodes.title: Hero price on tinted header
nodes.prompt: Make the price the hero and move the saving into a badge.
nodes.rationale: A tinted header band centres the price as the hero, with features and action below.

nodes.title: Horizontal upsell banner
nodes.prompt: A plan upgrade card: plan name, monthly price, three features with check icons and an Upgrade button.
nodes.rationale: A wide, in-context upsell that shows the jump from the current plan, splits price and features into two columns, and pairs the upgrade with a secondary compare action.

nodes.title: Sidebar stack, compact
nodes.prompt: Stack it for a narrow sidebar.
nodes.rationale: A compact 224px stack for a sidebar: name and price on one line, small checks and a small button.

nodes.title: Annual savings callout
nodes.prompt: Call out the annual saving in a highlighted strip under the price.

nodes.title: Inline upgrade strip
nodes.prompt: Make it a slim inline strip that sits above the table.
